props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the toggle.

props.name: value
props.description: A string value for the toggle group item. All items within a toggle group should use a unique value.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { modelValue: boolean; state: DataState; pressed: boolean; disabled: boolean; }
